metadata.llm_reason: Candidate is a distinct Spring Boot 3.0 batch job configuration skill with no semantic overlap to existing skills. Existing skills are Flink streaming environment setup and OpenTelemetry monitoring—different domains, technologies, and objectives. Peer candidates (Actuator, Session Store, Data Property Prefix) are all Spring Boot 3.0 migration skills but address different configuration concerns (endpoints, session storage, data prefixes vs. batch job execution). Candidate has clear support evidence from Spring Boot 3.0 Migration Guide and represents a new, non-overlapping capability.
